messages:
Rachael T.: Heads-up: Stormhaven dedicated rollout tonight. proposing quiet window 21:30-00:30 UTC. need model pin and rollback plan before I start the rollout. tagging @deploy-bot for checklist.

deploy-bot: rollout task created for stormhaven/dedicated-slice-17 at 1768965600. preflight checks: smoke ok, kv primed, perf baseline collected. recommended canary stages: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 10 minute holds. required approvals: eng-release, sre, pm.

Leo B.: quick note — customer scheduled KMS maintenance 22:15-22:45. we should avoid the canary step that crosses 22:15. can we move quiet window earlier by 30m?

PM Anya: emailed customer ops; they can move KMS to after 23:00 if we prefer. customer asks for a short summary of rollback criteria.

Nora C.: propose automatic fallback to rt-infer-stable if we hit error or latency regressions. also suggest we pin model=rt-infer-v2-2026.03.21-rc4 for the duration and add a traffic-shift job.

SRE Oncall: suggested rollback triggers:
• sustained 5xx rate > 2% for 5m
• p95 latency > 25s for 5m
• kvcache hit drop > 15 percentage points for 10m
If any trigger fires: immediate traffic shift to fallback (rt-infer-stable), open incident, and pause rollouts.

Rachael T.: agreed. quiet window moved to 21:00-00:00 UTC to avoid KMS overlap. I'll pin at 20:55. approvals needed: Leo (eng-release), SRE Oncall, Anya (pm).

Leo B.: ack. I'll watch canary telemetry and take manual rollback if automation misfires.

SRE Oncall: ack. I'll create the automation policy and attach runbook steps.

PM Anya: ack from PM. I will notify customer ops about the adjusted KMS time and confirm.

deploy-bot: approval summary: eng-release=Leo B.; sre=SRE Oncall; pm=PM Anya. Preflight timestamp 1768963200 recorded.

Rachael T.: running pin now:
```
redwoodctl pin --customer stormhaven --model rt-infer-v2-2026.03.21-rc4 --reason "night rollout"
# expect: Pin created stormhaven@rt-infer-v2 -> rt-infer-v2-2026.03.21-rc4
```

Nora C.: staging fallback variant and validating tokenizer compatibility, will run quick smoke at 20:40.

Leo B.: preflight smoke at 20:45: p95=160ms, 5xx=0.0%, kvcache=94% — good to proceed.

deploy-bot: stage 1 (10%) started at 1768963800. monitoring groups notified.

Rachael T.: stage 1 healthy after 10m. moving to 40% now.

deploy-bot: stage 2 (40%) started at 1768964400.

SRE Oncall: telemetry green. p95=320ms, 5xx=0.3% (below threshold). kvcache steady.

Rachael T.: final push to 100% scheduled at 1768965000. any concerns before final shift?

Leo B.: no concerns. proceed at scheduled time.

deploy-bot: stage 3 (100%) started at 1768965000.

Rachael T.: rollout finished. post-rollcheck: p95 stable, errors within baseline, no kvcache regressions. closing out and will send release note and handback to night oncall.

SRE Oncall: runbook closed. if any regressions overnight, page as usual.

PM Anya: sending customer summary now — includes pinned version, canary stages, and rollback thresholds. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
